name: Vikunja Tasks Connector
description: Kanban task manager connecting to your own Vikunja instance — create, assign, filter tasks and manage projects and labels.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_tasks
tools.description: Background: today/overdue/upcoming counts + recent tasks + active projects.

tools.name: skeleton_alert_tasks
tools.description: Alert on new overdue tasks or today's task count changes.

tools.name: connect_vikunja
tools.description: Connect a user's Vikunja instance via username + password. The password is forwarded to the backend service once, exchanged for a long-lived Personal Access Token, and discarded. Only the encrypted PAT is stored. Returns base_url + username on success.

base_url.description: Your Vikunja base URL, e.g. https://vikunja.example.com
base_url.title: Base Url

password.description: Your Vikunja password (used once to mint a long-lived API token, never stored).
password.title: Password

tools.name: connect_vikunja_with_pat
tools.description: Advanced connect: user pastes a pre-existing Vikunja Personal Access Token (Settings → API tokens in their Vikunja UI). The PAT is encrypted on bridge and stored at rest.

params_schema.description: Advanced: user pastes a pre-existing PAT minted in their Vikunja UI.

pat.description: Vikunja Personal Access Token (Settings → API tokens).
pat.title: Pat

params_schema.title: ConnectVikunjaWithPatParams

tools.name: disconnect_vikunja
tools.description: Disconnect from the user's Vikunja: revoke the stored API token in their instance and delete the local connection record.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Check whether the user has a Vikunja connected (read-only — never echoes the API token). Returns connected: bool plus base_url and username when connected.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a project. Pass project_name (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks') or project_id. The assignee field handles assignment internally — do NOT add a separate assign_task step. priority must be an integer: 0=none 1=low 2=medium 3=high 4=urgent 5=critical. due_date must be full ISO 8601 with time (e.g. '2026-06-15T00:00:00Z'), never a bare date.

project_id.description: Project (board) ID. Pass project_name instead if unknown.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project name to look up (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks'). Used when project_id unknown.
project_name.title: Project Name

bucket_id.description: Integer bucket ID. Use bucket_name instead if unknown.
bucket_id.title: Bucket Id

bucket_name.description: Bucket/column name (e.g. 'To-Do', 'Social Media'). Auto-resolved to bucket_id. Use this instead of bucket_id when you know the name.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

assignee.description: Name or email of person to assign (e.g. 'dmitrii@webhostmost.com'). Auto-resolved to Vikunja user. Optional — task is created even if resolution fails.
assignee.title: Assignee

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update any fields of a task (title, description, due_date, priority, percent_done, bucket, etc.).

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as done (done=true, percent_done=1.0).

tools.name: uncomplete_task
tools.description: Reopen a task — mark it as not done (done=false, percent_done=0). Inverse of complete_task.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_tasks
tools.description: Delete multiple tasks at once. Pass task_ids (list of integers) OR task_titles (list of names). When using task_titles, optionally pass project_name to narrow the search. Use when user asks to delete 2+ tasks in one request.

task_ids.description: List of integer task IDs to delete. Use this if you already have the IDs.
task_ids.title: Task Ids

task_titles.description: List of task titles to find and delete (e.g. ['Buy milk', 'Fix login bug']). Auto-resolved to task IDs.
task_titles.title: Task Titles

project_id.description: Narrow title search to a specific project. Recommended when using task_titles.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project name to narrow title search (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks').
project_name.title: Project Name

tools.name: complete_tasks
tools.description: Mark MULTIPLE tasks as done at once. Pass task_ids (list of integers) OR task_titles (list of names). When using task_titles, optionally pass project_name to narrow the search. Use when the user asks to complete/close 2+ tasks in one request.

task_ids.description: List of integer task IDs to complete. Use this if you already have the IDs.
task_ids.title: Task Ids

task_titles.description: List of task titles to find and complete (e.g. ['Buy milk', 'Fix login bug']). Auto-resolved to task IDs.
task_titles.title: Task Titles

project_id.description: Narrow title search to a specific project. Recommended when using task_titles.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project name to narrow title search (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks').
project_name.title: Project Name

BulkTaskItem.description:
One row of a non-delete batch. Deliberately says `ok` rather than
`deleted`: BulkDeleteItem's wording only fits removal, and reusing it for
'completed' or 'moved' would make the payload lie about what happened.
BulkTaskItem.title: BulkTaskItem

tools.name: create_subtask
tools.description: Create a subtask under a parent task. Returns the new subtask's task_id.

tools.name: list_subtasks
tools.description: List all subtasks of a given task, including their done/pending status.

task_id.description: Parent task ID to list subtasks for.
task_id.title: Task Id

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

SubtaskItem.description: Slim SDL task entity for subtask lists.
SubtaskItem.title: SubtaskItem

return_schema.description:
list_subtasks return — a REAL sdl.EntityList[SubtaskItem] (items=[...],
total=N, x-sdl='entity-list'). Parent task_id carried as an additive typed field.
return_schema.title: ListSubtasksResult

tools.name: toggle_checklist_item
tools.description: Check or uncheck a TipTap checklist item in a task description. Use item_index (0-based) from the visible checklist order.

task_id.description: Task whose description checklist to update.
task_id.title: Task Id

item_index.description: Zero-based index of the checklist item.
item_index.title: Item Index

checked.description: True to mark done, False to uncheck.
checked.title: Checked

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get full details of a single task by ID: title, description, done status, due date, priority, assignees, labels, and project. Use this to verify task state before updating, or when user asks about a specific task.

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Full SDL task entity. id=task_id, title=task title, kind="task".
return_schema.title: TaskEntity

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project (kanban board). Returns project_id.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update project title, description, or color.

tools.name: archive_project
tools.description: Archive a project (is_archived=true) — hide from active views but keep data.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project with all its tasks. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List all labels on this Vikunja instance. Returns label_id and title. Call this first when the user refers to a label by name — then use the returned label_id in add_label.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a new label with title and optional hex color. Returns label_id.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Permanently delete a label — removes it from all tasks.

label_id.description: Integer label ID from list_labels response. Never a name.
label_id.title: Label Id

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all active (non-archived) projects. Returns project_id and title. ALWAYS call this first when the user refers to a project by name — then use the returned project_id in list_project_buckets, filter_tasks, or create_task.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

ProjectItem.description:
Slim SDL project entity for project list results.

Carries `is_archived` / `is_favorite` so the narrator can answer
"show favorited / archived projects" by filtering the facts itself.
(Progress counts are intentionally NOT here — Vikunja's project object
has none; computing them needs an N× bucket_counts fan-out, which the
skeleton already does — answer "% complete" from skeleton context.)
ProjectItem.title: ProjectItem

return_schema.description:
list_projects — a REAL sdl.EntityList[ProjectItem] (items=[...], total=N,
x-sdl='entity-list').
return_schema.title: ListProjectsResult

tools.name: list_project_buckets
tools.description: List kanban columns (buckets) for a project — their names, IDs, and task counts. Use ONLY when the user asks WHAT BUCKETS OR COLUMNS EXIST in a project. Does NOT return task content — use get_bucket_tasks for that. Pass project_name (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks') OR project_id.

project_id.description: Integer project ID. Pass project_name instead if unknown.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project name to look up (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks'). Used when project_id is unknown.
project_name.title: Project Name

BucketEntity.description:
SDL kanban bucket. id=bucket_id, title=bucket title, kind="bucket".
sdl.Progress provides: total_count (task count), done_count.
BucketEntity.title: BucketEntity

return_schema.description: list_project_buckets — bucket names, IDs, and task counts.
return_schema.title: ListProjectBucketsResult

tools.name: get_bucket_tasks
tools.description: Get tasks from a specific kanban bucket/column. Use when the user asks WHAT TASKS ARE IN a named bucket (e.g. 'what tasks are in Backlog?', 'show me the To-Do column', 'tasks in Corporate Tasks bucket'). Do NOT use to list all buckets — use list_project_buckets for that. Pass bucket_name (resolved automatically) OR bucket_id. project_name and project_id are optional — omit to search across all projects.

bucket_name.description: Bucket/column name (e.g. 'Backlog', 'To-Do'). Case-insensitive. Use this OR bucket_id.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

bucket_id.description: Integer bucket ID. Use this OR bucket_name.
bucket_id.title: Bucket Id

project_name.description: Project name (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks'). Optional — if omitted, searches across all projects. Use this OR project_id.
project_name.title: Project Name

project_id.description: Integer project ID. Use this OR project_name.
project_id.title: Project Id

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

TaskItem.description:
Slim SDL task entity for list/search results.

Carries assignees / labels / percent_done / bucket_id so list reads can
answer "who is assigned", "which are labeled X", "% done", and "which
bucket" WITHOUT an N× get_task fan-out. `description` stays off the slim
item on purpose (HTML body would bloat large lists) — use get_task for it.
TaskItem.title: TaskItem

return_schema.description:
get_bucket_tasks / get_named_bucket_tasks — a REAL sdl.EntityList[TaskItem]
(items=[...], total=N); bucket coordinates carried as additive typed fields.
return_schema.title: GetBucketTasksResult

tools.name: count_tasks_per_bucket
tools.description: Count tasks in every kanban bucket for a project — returns per-bucket totals (total, done, pending) and project-level totals. Use when the user asks 'how many tasks', 'сколько задач', 'how many tasks are in each bucket', 'total tasks in project X', 'сколько всего задач'. Pass project_name (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks') or project_id. Counts are exact — queried directly from the database, no pagination limits.

project_id.description: Integer project ID. Pass project_name instead if unknown.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project name (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks'). Used when project_id is unknown.
project_name.title: Project Name

BucketEntity.description:
SDL kanban bucket. id=bucket_id, title=bucket title, kind="bucket".
sdl.Progress provides: total_count (task count), done_count.
BucketEntity.title: BucketEntity

return_schema.description: count_tasks_per_bucket — per-bucket and project-level task counts.
return_schema.title: CountTasksPerBucketResult

tools.name: rename_bucket
tools.description: Rename a kanban bucket (column) or update its WIP limit. Requires project_id and bucket_id — use list_project_buckets() first if you only know the bucket name.

limit.description: WIP limit (0 = no limit). Omit to keep existing.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: create_bucket
tools.description: Create a new kanban column (bucket) in a project. Requires project_id — use list_projects() first if you only know the project name. Optional WIP limit: 0 means no limit.

limit.description: WIP limit (0 = no limit). Omit for unlimited.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: delete_bucket
tools.description: Delete a kanban column (bucket) from a project. Irreversible — tasks in the deleted column are moved to the project's default column, not deleted. Requires project_id and bucket_id — call list_project_buckets() first if you only know the name.

tools.name: list_project_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in a specific project (paginated — default 50/page, max 200). Use when the user wants to SEE task titles/details, NOT to count tasks. For counting ('how many tasks', 'сколько задач') use count_tasks_per_bucket instead — this function returns a page, not the total. Pass project_name (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks') or project_id.

project_name.description: Project name (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks'). Used when project_id unknown.
project_name.title: Project Name

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

TaskItem.description:
Slim SDL task entity for list/search results.

Carries assignees / labels / percent_done / bucket_id so list reads can
answer "who is assigned", "which are labeled X", "% done", and "which
bucket" WITHOUT an N× get_task fan-out. `description` stays off the slim
item on purpose (HTML body would bloat large lists) — use get_task for it.
TaskItem.title: TaskItem

return_schema.description:
list_project_tasks — a REAL sdl.EntityList[TaskItem] (items=[...], total=N);
project coordinates carried as additive typed fields.
return_schema.title: ListProjectTasksResult

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get metadata for a single project — id, title, description, color, archived status. Pass project_id OR project_name (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks'). Use when user asks about a specific project or you need its ID from a name.

project_name.description: Project name to look up (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks').
project_name.title: Project Name

return_schema.description: Full SDL project entity. id=project_id, title=project title, kind="project".
return_schema.title: ProjectEntity

tools.name: delete_projects
tools.description: Permanently delete MULTIPLE projects at once, each with ALL its tasks. Pass project_ids (list of integers) OR project_names (list of names). Requires an explicit confirm=true on a second call; the first call only previews which projects would be deleted. Cannot be undone.

project_ids.description: List of integer project IDs to delete. Use this if you already have the IDs.
project_ids.title: Project Ids

project_names.description: List of project names to find and delete (e.g. ['Old board', 'Test']). Auto-resolved to IDs.
project_names.title: Project Names

confirm.description: Set true on a second call to actually delete. First call (default) only previews which projects would go.
confirm.title: Confirm

tools.name: assign_task
tools.description: Assign a person to a task. Pass task_name + assignee_query directly — do NOT call find_task or get_named_bucket_tasks first. If multiple tasks share the same name, also pass bucket_name to pick the right one. The bridge resolves assignee_query (name or email) to a Vikunja user ID automatically.

task_id.description: Integer task ID. Pass 0 when you only know the task by name — task_name will be used to auto-resolve it. Do NOT call find_task first.
task_id.title: Task Id

task_name.description: Task title to search for when task_id is unknown. Call assign_task directly with task_name — do NOT pre-search with find_task. If multiple tasks share the same name, also pass bucket_name to disambiguate.
task_name.title: Task Name

bucket_name.description: Bucket/column name to disambiguate when multiple tasks share the same title (e.g. 'Backlog'). Case-insensitive. Used only when task_name is set.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

assignee_query.description: Name or email of the person to assign (e.g. 'ignat', 'ignat@webhostmost.com'). The bridge resolves it to a Vikunja user ID automatically.
assignee_query.title: Assignee Query

tools.name: unassign_task
tools.description: Remove a Vikunja user (by integer user ID) from a task's assignee list.

assignee_vikunja_user_id.description: Integer Vikunja user ID (same one used in assign_task).
assignee_vikunja_user_id.title: Assignee Vikunja User Id

tools.name: add_label
tools.description: Attach an existing label (by integer label_id) to a task (by integer task_id). If you only know the label name, call create_label or ask the user for the numeric label_id — Vikunja addresses labels by ID, never by name.

label_id.description: Integer label ID — obtain via create_label response or Vikunja UI. Never label name.
label_id.title: Label Id

tools.name: remove_label
tools.description: Detach a label (by integer label_id) from a task (by integer task_id).

label_id.description: Integer label ID currently attached to this task.
label_id.title: Label Id

tools.name: set_due_date
tools.description: Set or change due date of a task. Pass integer task_id and due_date as ISO 8601 UTC string (e.g. '2026-04-25T12:00:00Z'). Convert relative dates ('Friday', 'tomorrow') in user's timezone first.

tools.name: set_priority
tools.description: Set task priority — integer 0 (none) to 5 (critical). Pass integer task_id.

tools.name: move_to_project
tools.description: Move a task to another project. Pass integer task_id and integer project_id, or pass project_name (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks') to resolve automatically.

project_id.description: Integer project ID. Pass project_name instead if unknown.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project name to look up (e.g. 'webhostmost tasks').
project_name.title: Project Name

tools.name: move_to_bucket
tools.description: Move a task to another kanban bucket (column). Pass integer task_id and integer bucket_id, or pass bucket_name + project_name (e.g. 'To-Do', 'webhostmost tasks') to resolve automatically.

bucket_id.description: Integer bucket ID from list_buckets response. Pass bucket_name + project_name instead if unknown.
bucket_id.title: Bucket Id

bucket_name.description: Bucket name (e.g. 'To-Do', 'In Progress'). Used when bucket_id unknown.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

project_name.description: Project name — needed to resolve bucket_name to bucket_id.
project_name.title: Project Name

tools.name: search_vikunja_users
tools.description: Search for Vikunja users by name or email fragment — use this before assign_task to discover who is available, or when the user asks who they can assign tasks to. Pass empty query to list all known users on the Vikunja instance.

query.description: Name or email fragment to search for (e.g. 'val', 'ignat', 'denis@'). Pass empty string to list all known users on this Vikunja instance.
query.title: Query

UserEntity.description:
Vikunja user as a canonical SDL entity (kind='user'): id=vikunja user id,
title=username. `connected` marks whether the user has linked their own
Imperal↔Vikunja connection. Mirrors the admin-ext UserRecord pattern.
UserEntity.title: UserEntity

return_schema.description:
search_vikunja_users return — a REAL sdl.EntityList[UserEntity] (items=[...],

tools.name: list_project_members
tools.description: List the members of a specific project (its assignable users — owner plus user/team shares). Use this when the user asks who is on a named project, e.g. 'who is on the WebHostMost Tasks team', 'участники проекта X', 'кто работает над проектом'. Pass project_name when you only know the name; it is resolved automatically. Prefer this over search_vikunja_users when the user names a project — it is project-scoped rather than instance-wide.

project_id.description: Integer project ID. Pass project_name instead if you only know the name.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project title to resolve (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks'). Used when project_id is unknown. Case-insensitive.
project_name.title: Project Name

Vikunja user as a canonical SDL entity (kind='user'): id=vikunja user id,
title=username. `connected` marks whether the user has linked their own

return_schema.description:
list_project_members return — a REAL sdl.EntityList[UserEntity]; project_id

task_titles.description: List of task titles to find and move (e.g. ['Buy milk', 'Fix login']). Auto-resolved to IDs.

bucket_name.description: Target bucket name (e.g. 'Done', 'In Progress'). Requires project_name to resolve.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

project_id.description: Project the bucket belongs to, and the scope for title lookups.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Project name (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks') — resolves both the bucket and the title search scope.
project_name.title: Project Name

tools.name: find_task
tools.description: Search tasks by title substring. Returns matching tasks with their integer task_id and project_id. Call this first when the user mentions a task by name and you don't have its integer ID — never invent task_id.

query.description: Substring of task title to search for. Returns matching tasks with their integer task_id, project_id, bucket_id.
query.title: Query

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

TaskItem.description:
Slim SDL task entity for list/search results.

Carries assignees / labels / percent_done / bucket_id so list reads can
answer "who is assigned", "which are labeled X", "% done", and "which
bucket" WITHOUT an N× get_task fan-out. `description` stays off the slim
item on purpose (HTML body would bloat large lists) — use get_task for it.
TaskItem.title: TaskItem

return_schema.description:
find_task — a REAL sdl.EntityList[TaskItem]; the search query carried as an
additive typed field.
return_schema.title: FindTaskResult

tools.name: filter_tasks
tools.description: Filter tasks with Vikunja expression. Operators: = != > < >= <= in like. Logical: && ||. Time helpers: now, now/d, now+7d, now-3d. Fields: title, description, done, due_date, start_date, end_date, priority, project_id, percent_done.

filter.description: Vikunja filter expression, e.g. 'done = false && project_id = 5'. If omitted, returns ALL tasks (no filter applied). NOTE: bucket_id is not a valid filter field — use list_buckets instead.
filter.title: Filter

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

answer "who is assigned", "which are labeled X", "% done", and "which
bucket" WITHOUT an N× get_task fan-out. `description` stays off the slim

TaskItem.title: TaskItem

return_schema.description:
list_my_tasks / list_overdue / list_today / list_upcoming / filter_tasks —

NO legacy {count, tasks:[dict]} wrapper.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task (markdown supported).

tools.name: mention_user
tools.description: Mention a user in a task comment. Vikunja auto-links '@username' and notifies. Use when user wants to notify/loop in someone.

username.description: Vikunja username to mention (without @). Vikunja auto-links and notifies.
username.title: Username

message.description: Optional context around the mention. If empty, plain '@username' is posted.
message.title: Message

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a task.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Edit the text of an existing comment on a task.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a comment from a task. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_comments
tools.description: Delete MULTIPLE comments on a task at once. Pass comment_ids to delete specific ones, or omit comment_ids entirely to delete EVERY comment on the task. Pass task_id, or task_name (+ optional bucket_name to disambiguate) to resolve it by title. Use when the user asks to delete 2+ comments, or 'delete all comments on task X'.

task_id.description: Integer task ID. Pass 0 when you only know the task by name.
task_id.title: Task Id

task_name.description: Task title to search for when task_id is unknown. Auto-resolved.
task_name.title: Task Name

bucket_name.description: Bucket/column name to disambiguate when multiple tasks share the same title.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

comment_ids.description: Specific comment IDs to delete. Omit (or pass an empty list) to delete EVERY comment on the task — use for 'delete all comments on task X'.
comment_ids.title: Comment Ids

BulkCommentItem.description:
One row of a comment batch (add or delete). `ok` rather than `deleted`/
`added`: this one model backs both directions, and a single field name
that lies about which verb ran would be worse than a slightly generic one.
BulkCommentItem.title: BulkCommentItem

tools.name: add_comments
tools.description: Add MULTIPLE comments to a task at once, in order. Pass task_id, or task_name (+ optional bucket_name to disambiguate) to resolve it by title. Use when the user asks to post 2+ comments in one request, e.g. a simulated work log.

task_id.description: Integer task ID. Pass 0 when you only know the task by name.
task_id.title: Task Id

task_name.description: Task title to search for when task_id is unknown. Auto-resolved.
task_name.title: Task Name

bucket_name.description: Bucket/column name to disambiguate when multiple tasks share the same title.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

comments.description: Comment texts to post, one call each, in this order (markdown supported).
comments.title: Comments

BulkCommentItem.description:
One row of a comment batch (add or delete). `ok` rather than `deleted`/
`added`: this one model backs both directions, and a single field name
that lies about which verb ran would be worse than a slightly generic one.
BulkCommentItem.title: BulkCommentItem

tools.name: ai_breakdown_task
tools.description: Break a task into subtasks using AI. Fetches the task title and description, generates N actionable subtask titles, then creates each as a real Vikunja subtask. Use when user says 'break this task into subtasks', 'разбей задачу', 'create a plan', or similar. Returns the list of created subtask IDs and titles.

task_id.description: ID of the task to break down into subtasks.
task_id.title: Task Id

context.description: Optional extra context or instructions for the breakdown.
context.title: Context

tools.name: upload_task_attachment
tools.description: Attach a file (photo, PDF, doc) to a task. Vikunja stores the file itself (max 20MB). Use when the user wants to attach/upload a photo or file to a task.

tools.name: list_task_attachments
tools.description: List all attachments (files/photos) on a task.

tools.name: delete_task_attachment
tools.description: Remove a file attachment from a task. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_task_attachments
tools.description: Remove SEVERAL file attachments from a task at once. Pass task_id and attachment_ids (list of integers from list_task_attachments). Use when the user wants to remove 2+ attachments in one request. Cannot be undone.

attachment_ids.description: List of integer attachment IDs to delete — from list_task_attachments.
attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids

tools.name: get_notification_status
tools.description: Check whether live Vikunja notifications (assigned/commented) are enabled.

tools.name: enable_task_notifications
tools.description: Turn on live notifications from your Vikunja — get notified in Imperal (bell/telegram, per your notification settings) when someone assigns you a task or comments on one. Registers a webhook on every one of your current Vikunja projects automatically — no manual setup needed. Projects created after enabling won't be covered until you disable and re-enable.

events.description: Vikunja event names to notify on. Defaults to being assigned a task and someone commenting on one. Advanced users can pass a longer list.
events.title: Events

tools.name: disable_task_notifications
tools.description: Turn off live Vikunja notifications and remove the webhooks from your Vikunja projects.

secrets.name: vikunja_bridge_key
secrets.description: API key the tasks backend (Vikunja bridge) authenticates with. Shared across all users; set once in Developer Portal → Secrets.
